name: Incriminating Photograph
subtitle: the wig is very slimming
rules: When this card enters play, name a non-resource card. -- The named card cannot be played.
flavor: Another photo in Dr. Unpeg Noon's distinct style.
notes: Card prints 'cannot be played'; catalog says 'cannot be deployed'.

name: Hangdog Alley
subtitle: refuge of outcasts
rules: If an attacking party is formed, it must have only 1 member.
flavor: Its confusing design and plentiful exits make Hangdog Alley the perfect retreat for those wishing to avoid the law. Justice is handled by the locals and traitors are dealt with swiftly.
notes: Card prints 'If an attacking party is formed'; catalog says 'When ...'.

name: Two-Headed Coin
subtitle: fixing the odds
rules: If you lose a coin flip, you may shuffle this card into your deck. If you do, reflip that coin and draw a card instead.
flavor: "78 in a row. A new record, I imagine."
notes: Card: 'If you lose a coin flip, you may shuffle this card into your deck. If you do, reflip that coin and draw a card instead.' Catalog: 'If you would lose a coin flip ... shuffle this card into its owner's deck. If you do, reflip that coin and use that result instead and draw a card.' Card has no 'use that result instead' clause and says 'your deck' not 'its owner's deck'; unsure whether play is identical. Footer reads 'Limited edition artwork by FangWei'.

name: Poisoned Blade
subtitle: looks good enough to eat
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- If the attached character inflicts damage to a character, destroy the damaged character. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
flavor: "Would you mind dipping those apples as well?"
notes: Card prints 'If the attached character inflicts damage'; catalog says 'When ...'.

name: Vander Malagut
subtitle: seething hatred, seductive wit
rules: UNIQUE EVONDAN -- All your other "sarcophyle" characters gain 1 speed. -- If a character is destroyed during a turn when this card damaged it, take control of that character instead. Reduce the amount of damage inflicted to it this turn to 0. It gains the "sarcophyle" subtype. -- If this card is destroyed, destroy all other "sarcophyle" characters.
notes: Unique-name line prints 'UNIQUE EVONDAN' (not the card name). Card says 'is destroyed' / 'damage inflicted' / 'If this card is destroyed'; catalog says 'would be destroyed' / 'already inflicted' / 'When ...'.
